# 0.加载已完成的GO通路映射表

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# 允许在项目根目录或 notebooks/ 目录中运行本 Rmd，不再写死具体项目的绝对路径。
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidates <- unique(c(start, file.path(start, "..")))
  candidates <- normalizePath(candidates, mustWork = FALSE)
  found <- candidates[file.exists(file.path(candidates, "config.yml")) |
                        file.exists(file.path(candidates, "config.example.yml"))]
  if (!length(found)) stop("请从项目根目录或 notebooks/ 目录运行本 Rmd。", call. = FALSE)
  normalizePath(found[[1]], mustWork = TRUE)
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
config_file <- file.path(project_root, "config.yml")
if (!file.exists(config_file)) stop("请先由 config.example.yml 创建并填写 config.yml。", call. = FALSE)
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_file)
input_config <- config$input
source(file.path(project_root, "src/00_utils.R"))

category_index_table <- read_csv(
  file.path(project_root, "src/gobp_category/GOBP_all_BP_classification_refined.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## 简单统计GOBP映射表格分类情况

```{r}
category_relation <- category_index_table %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Category),
    !is.na(Category_Merged)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Category, Category_Merged, name = "n_GO") %>%
  arrange(Category_Merged, desc(n_GO))

category_relation
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. 统计实际存在的映射
category_relation_raw <- category_index_table %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Category),
    !is.na(Category_Merged)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Category, Category_Merged, name = "n_GO")


# 2. 确定 Category 排序
#    让属于同一个 Category_Merged 的 Category 尽量聚在一起
category_order <- category_relation_raw %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_max(n_GO, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Category_Merged, desc(n_GO)) %>%
  pull(Category)


# 3. 补全所有 Category × Category_Merged 组合
category_relation <- category_relation_raw %>%
  complete(
    Category,
    Category_Merged,
    fill = list(n_GO = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = rev(category_order)
    )
  )


# 不着色0的格子
category_relation <- category_relation %>%
  mutate(
    n_GO_fill = ifelse(n_GO == 0, NA, n_GO)
  )


# 4. 绘图
p1 <- ggplot(
  category_relation,
  aes(
    x = Category_Merged,
    y = Category
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = n_GO_fill),
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = ifelse(n_GO == 0, "", n_GO)
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    trans = "sqrt",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Merged category",
    y = "Original category",
    fill = "GO terms"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}
# 读取GSEA的Summary的结果
read_xlsx_as_list <- function(file) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file)

  result <- lapply(sheets, function(sheet) {
    readxl::read_excel(file, sheet = sheet)
  })

  names(result) <- sheets

  return(result)
}

```

# 2. 映射GSVA结果

提取属于GSEA结果中的GSVA分数，并初步粗略的统计各类别下的趋势

```{r}
source(file.path(project_root, "src/gobp_trend/temporal_pathway_trend.R"))

# 时间点由 metadata 中的 Cycle 列匹配，不再依赖样本名中的 _R0_、_R1_ 等模式。
# 使用每个 Group 独立计算的 GSVA score；若某个 Group 缺文件会立即报错。
metadata <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(project_root, input_config$metadata_file),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
trend_config <- config$gobp_temporal_trend %||% list()
group_ids <- sort(unique(gsea.category.df$Group))

read_group_gsva <- function(group_id) {
  score_path <- file.path(
    project_root, "data/gsva/by_group", safe_path_component(group_id), "gsva_scores.rds"
  )
  if (!file.exists(score_path)) stop("找不到分组 GSVA 分数：", score_path, call. = FALSE)
  readRDS(score_path)
}

run_group_temporal_trend <- function(group_id, thresholds) {
  run_temporal_pathway_analysis(
    score_matrix = read_group_gsva(group_id),
    annotation = gsea.category.df,
    group_name = group_id,
    sample_metadata = metadata,
    sample_column = input_config$sample_column,
    group_column = input_config$group_column,
    cycle_column = input_config$cycle_column,
    cycle_order = trend_config$cycle_order %||% NULL,
    zscore = trend_config$zscore %||% FALSE,
    thresholds = thresholds
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 探索版本：由当前数据的变化分布自动建议阈值。
trend_auto <- setNames(
  lapply(group_ids, run_group_temporal_trend, thresholds = list(mode = "auto")),
  group_ids
)

# 例如查看 CQ；时间来源应显示为 metadata。
trend_auto[[group_ids[[1]]]]$settings$time_source
trend_auto[[group_ids[[1]]]]$settings$time_map
trend_auto[[group_ids[[1]]]]$diagnostics
```

```{r}
# 最终版本：参数写在 config.yml 的 gobp_temporal_trend.thresholds 中。
# 默认示例的含义为：<0.10 的 pathway 变化、<0.07 的 CAS 变化不赋方向；
# 总动态范围 <0.25 视为低动态；至少 60% 通路支持总体方向。
final_thresholds <- trend_config$thresholds %||% list(
  mode = "manual",
  epsilon_pathway = 0.10,
  epsilon_category = 0.07,
  amplitude_cutoff = 0.25,
  dcs_cutoff = 0.60
)
trend_final <- setNames(
  lapply(group_ids, run_group_temporal_trend, thresholds = final_thresholds),
  group_ids
)

trend_final[[group_ids[[1]]]]$summary
trend_final[[group_ids[[1]]]]$CAS
trend_final[[group_ids[[1]]]]$direction_metrics
```

```{r}
# 保存完整对象及关键统计表，供后续解释和绘图使用。
trend_output_dir <- file.path(gsea_output_dir, "gobp_temporal_trends")
dir.create(trend_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (group_id in names(trend_final)) {
  result <- trend_final[[group_id]]
  group_dir <- file.path(trend_output_dir, safe_path_component(group_id))
  dir.create(group_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(result, file.path(group_dir, "temporal_pathway_analysis.rds"))
  readr::write_tsv(result$summary, file.path(group_dir, "category_trend_summary.tsv"))
  readr::write_tsv(result$CAS, file.path(group_dir, "category_activity_score.tsv"))
  readr::write_tsv(result$direction_metrics, file.path(group_dir, "direction_metrics.tsv"))
  readr::write_tsv(result$pathway_trajectory, file.path(group_dir, "pathway_trajectory.tsv"))
}
```
